title: Next IREN perhaps? DUOT (Dous Technologies)
summary: Seeing a lot of people chase random AI tickers again and it kinda reminds me of early IREN days.Back then IREN wasn’t some flashy AI story. It was just quietly building power and infrastructure while everyone ignored it because it didn’t fit the hype narrative yet. DUOT gives me a similar vibe, just way earlier and way smaller.Most microcap AI names are basically slide decks and press releases. DUOT actually has hardware deployed. Physical edge compute pods running in the real world, low power, ultra low latency, placed where the data is generated instead of shipping everything back to a hyperscaler.They already have units in the field and more in backlog. Talking to telcos, healthcare, and even Amazon / a hyperscaler. That’s a lot more real than most stuff I see pumped here.The part people miss is latency. A lot of future AI use cases break if latency or bandwidth isn’t guaranteed. Robotics, AR/VR, surgical stuff, autonomous systems, etc. You can’t solve that by just building bigger centralized data centers. Physics doesn’t care.That’s why edge compute exists. DUOT is already doing it, just quietly, and the market cap is tiny like IREN was before anyone cared.Not saying it’s the next IREN or a guaranteed 10x. Just saying this is the kind of “boring infrastructure first, narrative later” setup that people usually only notice after it’s already moved.submitted by/u/pilotsoar89[link][comments]
